description: Implement composable virtual models with recursive operation tree, description field, and composition builder UI.
summary: 4-phase implementation: backend data model + resolution, API layer, frontend composition builder, testing + polish

phases.title: Backend: Data Model + Resolution Engine
phases.description: Database migration, Go CompositionNode struct, repository read/write, set operations (union/intersection/difference), recursive evaluateNode with cycle detection, description field migration.

phases.title: Backend: API Layer + Dependencies
phases.description: Update create/update/preview handlers for composition field, add GET /dependencies endpoint, add delete guard (409 on dependent VMs), wire description field through API.

phases.title: Backend: Testing
phases.description: Unit tests for set operations, circular reference detection, recursive tree evaluation. Integration tests for nested composition, post-operation filter/sort, delete guard, edge cases.

phases.title: Frontend: Composition Builder + Description
phases.description: Create CompositionBuilder.svelte (recursive), VMBlock, OperationBlock, OperationSelector, AddSourceButton. Integrate into VirtualModelForm with mode toggle. Wire live preview. Add description textarea to form and list display. Dependency warnings, delete confirmation, empty states.
